description: LEADING-term test of the deuteron-wall closure via the m=1 level-1/2 alien term of the Gevrey-1/2 binding period (derived ω₀=1/√2, A_ω=4√2 e^-3/8, scale m_e, no tuning): ceiling m_e·A_ω=1.987 MeV < B_D=2.225 MeV, so the LEADING term undershoots (~0.21 MeV at substrate). NOT a refutation: the full alien-calculus trans-series Σ_m S_m A_ω^m e^{-mω₀/√x} Φ_m (dualized entanglement energy of the 2-nucleon bipartition) is unbounded by A_ω and OPEN. Scope-(a); no fit.
verdict: Scope-(a), LEADING-TERM ONLY (not a refutation of the route): the single m=1 level-1/2 alien term (derived ω₀=1/√2, A_ω=4√2 e^-3/8, scale m_e) has ceiling m_e·A_ω=1.9867 MeV < B_D=2.2245 MeV and gives ~0.21 MeV at the substrate coupling, so the leading alien term alone UNDERSHOOTS. The FULL alien-calculus trans-series Σ_m S_m A_ω^m e^{-mω₀/√x} Φ_m (bridge equation) is NOT bounded by A_ω and is OPEN — the leading ceiling does not exclude it. Physical frame: B_D is the dualized entanglement energy of the 2-nucleon bipartition, carried by the dual channel where the alien calculus lives; the perturbative Vol face is 0 (Hopf). Next: compute S_m/Φ_m for the bipartition dual. No fit; no wiring.
scope: (a) — leading m=1 alien term undershoots; full alien-calculus trans-series (dualized entanglement energy) open
